description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 tests of problems/hjweno_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.esm (model HJWenoEikonalMMS, test mms_eikonal) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*hjweno(u) + S|g'| with manufactured solution g = sin(2 pi x); the assertions pin ic wiring (L2_error 0 at t=0 within 1e-9) and bound the fifth-order error (L2_error < 1e-3 at t=0.1, ~6.7e-8 at N=64). Julia tolerances pinned tight so the temporal truncation stays below the HJ-WENO spatial error. The order-of-accuracy claim is gated by tests/conformance/convergence/hjweno_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
